paragraphs: Write a program that reads user input until an empty line is entered. For each non-empty line the program splits the string by spaces ` `  and prints the last part of the string.
Tip! You can find out the length of the array like this:
prompt.codeSnippet:
String[] parts = {"one", "two", "three"};
System.out.println("Number of parts: " + parts.length);
